_doc: Dock shrink-on-scroll steps (web src/lib/dockLayout.js dockCollapseStep, iOS Lib/DockLayout.swift DockCollapse). offsetY: 0 at the top, more negative further down; delta < 0 = scrolling down. Each case starts from { collapsed: false, travel: 0 } and feeds the samples in order.

cases.name: a steady scroll down shrinks once 24 pt have been travelled
a small reversal (a finger wobble or a bounce) keeps it shrunk
a real scroll up expands it
near the top it is always full size
a reversal restarts the run, even mid-way
